style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Candy Cane Wreath Christmas Decoration
style.toneOfVoice: Add a cheerful festive touch to your home with this artificial 55cm candy cane wreath. Designed with a playful red and white striped theme, it brings a joyful burst of colour and classic Christmas charm to any door, wall or interior display. The carefully arranged foliage provides a full and balanced shape, creating a natural-looking base that beautifully showcases the iconic candy cane detailing. Its vibrant design captures the spirit of the season, making it a perfect choice for both traditional and contemporary festive décor schemes. Compact yet impactful at 55cm, this wreath is ideal for smaller spaces or for layering with other seasonal decorations. It pairs effortlessly with fairy lights, garlands and baubles to create a coordinated and eye-catching festive look throughout your home. Designed for repeated use, this candy cane wreath offers a fun and stylish way to brighten your Christmas celebrations year after year. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath Width: W55cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
